decisions.reason: The handle family builds directly on the firm’s established door-hardware knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and refine the line rather than drop it.
The multifunctional handle draws on existing mechanical and electronic access capabilities, giving the firm enough absorptive capacity to learn from market response and keep improving it.
This handle line sits within the firm’s core product domain, allowing it to recognize and act on early signals without discarding the product.
The award-winning collection has strong early proof and a dedicated website presence, which the firm can absorb and build on with its design and ergonomic know-how.

The new finish is evaluated with the firm’s finishing know-how and applies to existing handles, but as a more easily replaceable surface option it carries a somewhat higher withdrawal risk if demand stays weak.
